capabilityLimits: Native SP shared-authority worlds cover actual unobserved application timeout and actual cancellation/late consumer receipts. Independent real two-client reconnect/host-transfer legs exercise old commands and actual persisted receipts in both orders.
Cancellation requests alone cannot satisfy application: the original native cancellation acknowledgment and exactly one definition-priced refund are mandatory.
Multiplayer has no save/load. Host transfer is backed by an actual current reconnect checkpoint; no AI state, receipt, effect, epoch or sequence is fabricated.
